Before You Ask

Two things. A course of 26 short videos that teaches you how to take on a commercial client properly, and 14 ready made packs, one for each kind of commercial space, that do the asking for you. A pack is a set of 14 files, everything from the questions you ask in the first meeting right up to the page the client signs before you start designing.

Yes. It starts from the very beginning and assumes zero experience with commercial work or with systems. You watch a real store and a real restaurant get onboarded end to end, and then you can run any of the other 12.

You get all 14 packs whatever your project is. The course teaches a store and a restaurant end to end because they are the two far ends of the range, and every other space sits between them. Module 7 walks you through the other 12 in Brief, and each pack comes with its own guide that runs it start to finish.

They never do it all at once, and that is the whole design of the system. A light set of questions before the yes, and the deeper details get asked after either on WhatsApp or on a meeting.

Also, Module 6 gives you the exact methods for the client who pushes back or goes silent.

No. The packs sit in Notion, and Notion's free plan covers everything here. Everything that goes to your client goes on WhatsApp or your choice of medium. There is nothing to buy on top of this.

Yes. You only run the zones your project actually has.

Straight after payment. You are taken to your dashboard with everything inside it, and you also get an order confirmation email with your access within 5 to 10 minutes. Check spam if you do not see it. Log in with the email/phone number you paid with and start.
